skills.name: flutter-flame-gamedev
skills.description: Skill GLOBAL de desarrollo de videojuegos con Flutter + Flame — arquitectura de componentes, coordenadas isométricas, gameplay (unidades/IA/combate/recursos), pipeline de assets, performance móvil y testing. Úsalo para CUALQUIER tarea de código de gameplay en un proyecto Flutter/Flame (no solo The Best Empire). NO congela versiones de API: antes de usar una API de Flutter/Flame/Dart sensible a versión, consulta Context7 o la documentación oficial actual — las reglas de este skill son de diseño/arquitectura, no un pin de API.

skills.name: hunter-design
skills.description: Design system skill for hunter. Activate when building UI components, pages, or any visual elements. Provides exact color tokens, typography scale, spacing grid, component patterns, and craft rules. Read references/DESIGN.md before writing any CSS or JSX. Includes ultra-mode visual journey: read references/ANIMATIONS.md, references/LAYOUT.md, references/COMPONENTS.md, and references/INTERACTIONS.md for full motion and layout details.

skills.name: hyperframes-animation
skills.description: All animation knowledge for HyperFrames — atomic motion rules, multi-phase scene blueprints, scene transitions, broader motion-design techniques, AND the seven runtime adapters (GSAP default, plus Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js, CSS keyframes, Web Animations API, TypeGPU). Use for any motion or animation task: pick 2-4 rules and compose, or load a blueprint, or look up runtime-specific API (e.g. GSAP eases / Lottie player / Three.js mixer). Also covers auditing an existing composition's choreography (animation map) and 24 named text-animation effects. HyperFrames-native: single paused timeline, seek-safe, deterministic.

skills.name: hyperframes-core
skills.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

skills.name: hyperframes-creative
skills.description: Non-animation creative direction for HyperFrames videos. Use for design spec (frame.md / design.md) handling, palettes, typography, narration, beat planning, audio-reactive visuals, composition patterns, and brand / style decisions. For atomic motion patterns and scene blueprints, use `hyperframes-animation`.

skills.name: hyperframes-registry
skills.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

skills.name: inyeccionesadomiciliosantiago-design
skills.description: Design system skill for inyeccionesadomiciliosantiago. Activate when building UI components, pages, or any visual elements. Provides exact color tokens, typography scale, spacing grid, component patterns, and craft rules. Read references/DESIGN.md before writing any CSS or JSX. Includes ultra-mode visual journey: read references/ANIMATIONS.md, references/LAYOUT.md, references/COMPONENTS.md, and references/INTERACTIONS.md for full motion and layout details.

skills.name: media-use
skills.description: Agent Media OS, the single skill for every media need in a HyperFrames project. Resolve BGM, SFX, image, icon, brand logo, voice, color grade, or LUT into a frozen local file or paste-ready block + ledger record (one verb, `resolve`); generate via TTS / music / image models when the catalog misses; produce voiceover, transcription, captions, and background removal through one shared audio engine; operate on media (cut / reframe / transform); and reuse assets across projects. Also use for vague feedback that real footage looks dark, flat, boring, should feel retro/camcorder/print/ASCII, needs privacy, or needs a media reveal.

skills.name: super-prompt-maestro
skills.description: Especificación completa del Super Prompt Maestro (v2.1) — el estándar de trabajo del usuario para desarrollo con Claude Code. Las reglas esenciales ya están cargadas de forma permanente vía ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; invoca ESTE skill solo cuando necesites el detalle completo, es decir cuando: (1) la tarea se clasificó HIGH o PRODUCTION, (2) una regla del CLAUDE.md global necesita más detalle o matices, (3) dos fuentes de información entran en contradicción y hace falta el protocolo de resolución completo, (4) la tarea requiere un protocolo especializado (bug, feature nueva, UI desde referencia visual, migración, seguridad), o (5) el usuario pide explícitamente "consulta el super prompt" / "v2.1" / el protocolo completo. NO lo invoques para tareas LOW/MEDIUM triviales — el CLAUDE.md global ya basta.
